about: Daily AI matchup reads. ai/context-YYYY-MM-DD.json is built by .github/workflows/context.yml (featured games with ratings, standings, injuries, plus yourRecord: the AI's own graded history). ai/YYYY-MM-DD.json is written by a scheduled Claude task. ai/record.json is the grading of every past read against results, rebuilt each morning by the same workflow.

<league>:<ESPN event id>.headline: one line
<league>:<ESPN event id>.pick: team abbreviation (graded the next morning against the result)
